content.title: Better Sleep Is Supercharging Your Iron Recovery
content.body: Your ferritin jumped 56% in 6 weeks, and now your sleep quality is up 13 points. These wins are connected. Your body absorbs iron most efficiently during deep sleep—when cellular repair kicks into high gear. By improving your sleep, you're not just resting better. You're accelerating your entire recovery.

metadata.rationale: Day 45 medical-lifestyle correlation reveal. Cognitive reframing technique - connect sleep improvement to lab results for synergistic understanding. content.title: Did You Know?
content.body: Sleep deprivation impairs decision-making as much as being legally drunk. Adults who sleep 6 hours or less have 200% higher risk of burnout and 50% reduced work productivity. Protect 7-8 hours of sleep like you'd protect an important meeting.

source.citation: Sleep Health Journal 2023; Singapore Workplace Productivity Study 2022
